feat(profile)!: object-section wire v2, native v1 removal, debug profile dumps

Replace the position-coded 68-slot profile wire with a self-describing
object-section format on both sides of the Kotlin<->native contract, drop the
native v1 JSON path, and dump the effective runtime profile into the exported
debug folder.

BREAKING CHANGE: the transport is now wire v2 only. Kotlin and native are
version-bound: the old v2 (12-byte header + 68 u64 core) and v3 (core +
middleware/option sections) containers are gone, native no longer parses v1
offsets.json, and a v1 document must be converted on the Kotlin side first.

Native
- profile/binary.cpp: parse/serialize v2 as a 16-byte little-endian header
  `u32 magic + u16 version(2) + u16 frontend + u16 backend + u16 middleware +
  u16 release_len + u16 reserved`, then the release string, `u16 section_count`,
  then per section `u8 name_len + name + u32 entry_count` and per entry
  `u8 key_len + key + u64 value`. Presence is key occurrence (an omitted field
  is not a provided 0); values are raw u64 bit patterns (signed = two's
  complement) and are never clamped; only the active route's `route.*` section
  is written or accepted; unknown sections/keys are ignored; duplicate keys are
  last-wins. `kSections` is the single section/key authority.
- profile/model.h: split `kernel_offsets` into ProfileMeta, TaskStructOffsets,
  CredTemplate, KernelOffsets, KernelMisc (optional), RouteGeometry (optional)
  and the execution settings; route layouts keep `std::optional` members.
- Migrate util/address_space/runtime_struct_offsets/select_stack_route/backend
  to the split model and drop the optional-value clamps.
- Delete `core/legacy/` (v1 JSON offsets.json parser, converter, entrypoint
  starter) and its host test; drop them from CMakeLists/Makefile.
- Make the one-shot multicast int32 -> size_t widening explicit, clearing a
  -Wsign-conversion warning (codegen unchanged).

Android / app
- profile-core/NativeProfile.kt: rewrite to the v2 object-section codec
  (`toBinary`/`fromBinary`), optional fields as nullable, and add
  `patchSafeMode()` (scans the meta section; replaces the removed fixed-offset
  `safeModeOffset()`).
- route configs (Multicast/Select/Tcp/RouteConfig/RouteKind): `entries()` now
  yields the short section keys (`waiter_off`, `waiter_shift`, `attempts`, ...)
  with `ULong` raw values and `apply()` restores typed fields; drop the
  `toConfigUInt/toConfigULong` clamps and make route fields nullable where the
  native layout is `std::optional`.
- Profile/ProfileResolver/ProfileExporter: align to the nullable/typed model and
  the v2 reader; execution values keep their raw bits.
- AndroidProfileConfigController: fail-closed validation now rejects negative or
  out-of-range unsigned route fields instead of silently clamping; add a
  verbatim `renderResolvedForDebug()`.
- Debug export: write the effective runtime profile into the same per-attempt
  folder as `profile.conf` (resolved HOCON, nothing trimmed) and `profile.bin`
  (the exact GLK1 bytes handed to native) via MediaStore.
- GhostlockUserService/AndroidGhostlockRepository: safe_mode now goes through
  `patchSafeMode()`; the blob length check follows the 16-byte header.

Docs
- AGENTS.md: pin the branch to wire v2, forbid ad-hoc version bumps, and note
  that the native v1 path is gone.
- PROFILE_SCHEMA(.md/_ZH): document the v2 layout and section/key tables.
- SUPPORTED_DEVICES(.md/_ZH): register Red Magic 8 Pro (5.15.167), the only
  builtin profile that was missing a row.
- src/core/README, the wire-v2 object-sections plan and the Kotlin handoff.

Verification
- `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :profile-core:test` green, golden refrozen.
- `make -C src native-host-tests` green; NDK build zero-warning; `lint-tidy` 0.
- `cmp_disasm` against the pre-fix build: strict-IDENTICAL for every present
  target, including `do_kernel5_fake_lock_route`; the two multicast workers are
  inlined in both builds.
- Device gate (cold boot, single multicast route) still pending.

commit.message:
feat(multicast,extract,app): one-shot-only multicast, offline geometry, import UX

Remove the unmaintained multicast resident writer and make the one-shot route
the single multicast path; teach the extractor to derive the whole 5.x one-shot
geometry offline (no root/device); rework the local-image import flow.

BREAKING CHANGE: the resident multicast writer and its profile fields are gone.
5.15 runs one-shot multicast only.

Native
- Delete MulticastWaiterRoute (class + header), resident_route(),
  kernel5_resident_{start,write,stop}, the resident_write / w1_resident_repair
  middleware hooks, the backend resident fast path, the w1c step and
  release_resident_heap.
- Drop profile fields: multicast_resident, mcast_fake_lock/task_offset,
  mcast_lock_slots_*, off_mcast_fake_bss, multicast_*_settle timings;
  MulticastWaiterLayout keeps only waiter/buffer/task/lock offsets.
- attack_write now always heap-sprays and runs the middleware route; the
  one-shot do_kernel5_fake_lock_route and w2_fast_repair_* are unchanged.

Extractor (tools/extract_rs)
- Every 5.x multicast profile emits the full one-shot geometry (probe-derived
  waiter_off/buffer_size + BTF task/lock + compact_waiter) and the 5.x
  KernelSnitch defaults, no longer gated on the android13 train tag.
- waiter_off is derived statically from the target image's setsockopt/futex
  stack frames: (Σsetsockopt − greqs_off) − (Σfutex − waiter_local). The
  A301SO image reproduces its hardware-probed 0x60; a unit golden pins it
  (PD2361 yields 0x50).
- kernel_phys_load: parse the UEFI platform memory-map table
  (`0x<base>,0x<size>,"Kernel"`) when xbl_config carries no FDT map; payload/OTA
  extraction now also pulls the uefi partition; add a --uefi flag.
- Legacy JSON maps exactly the remote/main field set (no mcast, no
  kernel_major, no empty_zero_page, no shizuku); kernel_major defaults to 6.
- New tools/verify_kernels.py batch verification harness; golden: A301SO
  `--format conf` matches the bundled profile field-for-field (only
  recommend_shizuku differs, intentionally 0).

Android / UI
- "Import offsets.conf (HOCON)" -> "(v2)"; parse-local-image is now a
  two-level menu: payload.bin, or boot.img with optional xbl_config.img /
  uefi.img (both selectable). A profile missing sidecar-only fields
  (kernel_phys_load) gets a fill-it hint after parsing.
- Parsed profiles auto-load on save; the status "go to configuration" link is
  no longer a no-op; export no longer gains a ".txt" suffix.
- BuiltinProfileCatalog excludes *-template from device matching, so a
  template can no longer mark a device "supported".
- Builtin profiles: restore Xperia 1V (5.15.189) and register Red Magic 8 Pro
  (5.15.167).

Docs
- docs/analysis/remove-multicast-resident-plan.md (L-level plan + verification);
  PROFILE_SCHEMA/defaults/templates and component docs updated.

Verification
- native: host tests pass, NDK build zero-warning, lint 0 findings, cmp_disasm
  reviewed (do_one_write loses only the resident fast path; workers MISSING).
- app: testDebugUnitTest green; extractor: cargo test (34) + fmt clean.
- device: one-shot multicast gate PASS; parse -> save -> auto-load flow tested.

  host-neutral defaults with Android-only overrides declared per policy

  no vtable/std::visit); side-effecting hooks marked [[gnu::noinline]] so LTO
  cannot inline route bodies into the attack functions
- exploit_procedure: drop the 7 virtual hooks; call route::middleware::*; move
  the W1b scratch repair into the procedure behind a capability projection
- multicast/tcp route units: policy hook definitions, empty procedure bindings

  diff (vtable indirect -> direct call, optional ABI equivalent)

commit.message:
refactor(profile): align Kotlin and native field signedness

Every profile field now mirrors the native storage signedness end to end:
uint8_t/uint32_t slots are UInt and uint64_t slots are ULong on the Kotlin
side, the execution getters return uint32_t, and the wire header magic/version
and route wire values are unsigned. Only the int32_t address fields
(pselect_waiter_shift, mcast_waiter_off) stay signed, and the 64-bit transport
glue keeps Long so it can carry negative int32 values and large uint64 values
through the same slots.

commit.message:
refactor(native): reorganize sources and make routes pluggable (GLK1 v4)

Reorganize core sources into kernel/, profile/, route/, race/, attack/,
support/ and legacy/; split common.h into kernel/constants.hpp,
profile/accessors.hpp, support/decls.hpp and route/route_api.hpp.

Introduce ExploitProcedure (Template Method) with a single
make_exploit_procedure(session, RouteKind) selector, and a RoutePolicy
concept (Select/Tcp/Multicast) whose per-route Route class and Procedure
are folded into each route file. RouteKind and the route catalog are
shared across Kotlin and native with agreement tests.

Modernize the codebase: int->int32_t, Status as bool, FatalError on fatal
paths, std::optional for recoverable steps, typed TargetProfile getters,
and explicitly qualified secondary namespaces.

GLK1 v4: fixed common slots plus per-route sections. Route-specific
parameters (multicast geometry, off_mcast_fake_bss, pselect_waiter_shift,
per-route execution tuning) move out of the shared schema on both sides;
native kernel_offsets stays a flat data struct and Kotlin carries a
RouteConfig sealed hierarchy. The remote/main legacy wire format is
unchanged.

Tests: native host tests, route catalog agreement, GLK1 round-trip.
